elements_selected.content: Create src/web/templates/page.html by extracting the single-page view from routes.rs::page_handler() and build.rs::render_page(). Template extends base.html. Overrides {% block content %} with: breadcrumbs, page title, rendered markdown content (page.content_html|safe), backlinks panel, transclusion cards panel, SVG bridge lines JS, mobile tooltip preview JS. Overrides {% block scripts %} with edit-mode JS (save handler, toggle) wrapped in {% if mode == 'serve' %} conditional. Variables: page.title, page.slug, page.content_html, page.backlinks[], page.outlinks[], page.breadcrumbs[], page.transclusion_cards, page.is_new, page.raw_escaped, mode.
